## Feature request issue

Approved by a maintainer in: #<!-- issue number -->

## Skill file

Path: `.github/skills/<feature-name>/SKILL.md`

- [ ] This PR adds or updates a `SKILL.md` that describes the feature
- [ ] The skill has `name` and `description` front matter
- [ ] The skill states purpose, scope and out-of-scope items
- [ ] The skill lists affected components (API spec, schema, handlers, config)
- [ ] The skill has step-by-step implementation instructions
- [ ] The skill lists required tests, metrics and documentation updates
- [ ] The skill has verifiable acceptance criteria

## Summary

<!-- What does the feature do and why? Written by you, in your own words. -->

## Verification

- [ ] Unit and integration tests added or updated
- [ ] Prometheus metrics added (see `.github/instructions/metrics.instructions.md`)
- [ ] Documentation updated in `docs/`
- [ ] `just fmt`, `just lint` and `just test` pass locally
- [ ] Generated code was regenerated, not hand-edited

## Author declaration

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] I understand every change in this PR and can explain it in review
- [ ] I have signed the CLA
